summary: import_tasks takes a file option or a free-form file name; keywords like loops and conditionals apply to the imported tasks, so use include_tasks if you need them on the statement.
questions: Do conditionals on import_tasks apply to each task?
How do I specify the file for import_tasks?

answer_card.title: import_tasks parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `file` or free-form: `- import_tasks: file.yml`
- Keywords/conditionals apply to the **imported tasks**; loops don't work. Use `include_tasks` for that.
